TABLE.NAME: assignsubmission_refchecker
TABLE.COMMENT: One reference checking job per assignment submission

FIELD.NAME: assignment
FIELD.COMMENT: The assignment instance this job relates to.

FIELD.NAME: submission
FIELD.COMMENT: The submission this job relates to. Carries userid, groupid and attemptnumber already.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: notapplicable, pending, extracting, checking, norefs, complete, failed or cancelled.

FIELD.NAME: generation
FIELD.COMMENT: Bumped on every re-trigger. Tasks abort when this no longer matches their custom data.

FIELD.NAME: requeues
FIELD.COMMENT: How many times the reconcile task has revived this job.

FIELD.NAME: deferrals
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive task runs put off by the pacer without sending a request. Reset by any run that gets through.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the sorted source file content hashes, so an unchanged resubmission skips re-checking.

FIELD.NAME: totalrefs
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of references extracted.

FIELD.NAME: checkedrefs
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of references checked so far.

FIELD.NAME: issuerefs
FIELD.COMMENT: References with at least one reported issue.

FIELD.NAME: truncated
FIELD.COMMENT: Set when the extracted reference count hit the configured cap.

FIELD.NAME: sectionheading
FIELD.COMMENT: The bibliography heading that was matched, shown so students can sanity-check what was found.

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Machine readable failure code. Never shown raw to students.

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Human readable failure detail. Teachers and admins only.

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: The unique id for this job.

INDEX.NAME: assignment-status
INDEX.COMMENT: Teacher side aggregate queries over an assignment.

INDEX.NAME: status-timemodified
INDEX.COMMENT: Used by the reconcile task to find abandoned jobs.

TABLE.NAME: assignsubmission_refchecker_refs
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per reference extracted from a submission

FIELD.NAME: jobid
FIELD.COMMENT: The checking job this reference belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: submission
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised from the job so privacy deletes and backup are a single hop.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Position in the bibliography.

FIELD.NAME: rawref
FIELD.COMMENT: The reference exactly as the student wrote it.

FIELD.NAME: sourcefile
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the submitted file this reference came from.

FIELD.NAME: refhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the normalised reference. The cache key.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, checked or error. Doubles as the chunking cursor.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Per reference retry counter, capped at 3.

FIELD.NAME: matchstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: verified, partial, mismatch or notfound.

FIELD.NAME: matchconfidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Overall confidence 0-100.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: crossref, openalex or notfound.

FIELD.NAME: foundauthors
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of author display names.

FIELD.NAME: numissues
FIELD.COMMENT: How many issues were reported, so the job counters can be aggregated without parsing JSON.

FIELD.NAME: issues
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of issue strings. Display only, never queried.

FIELD.NAME: formatted
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON object of formatted citations: apa, mla, iso690, bibtex. Display only.

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: The unique id for this reference.

TABLE.NAME: assignsubmission_refchecker_text
TABLE.COMMENT: The reference list a student pasted into the submission form, when the assignment asks for one

FIELD.NAME: assignment
FIELD.COMMENT: The assignment instance this text belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: submission
FIELD.COMMENT: The submission this text belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: referencetext
FIELD.COMMENT: The reference list exactly as the student pasted it. Plain text, never HTML.

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: The unique id for this pasted reference list.

KEY.NAME: submission
KEY.COMMENT: At most one pasted reference list per submission.

TABLE.NAME: assignsubmission_refchecker_cache
TABLE.COMMENT: Shared cache of lookup results keyed by normalised reference hash. Holds no student authored text.

FIELD.NAME: refhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the normalised reference.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the found bibliographic record. Never contains the submitted reference text.

FIELD.NAME: hits
FIELD.COMMENT: How many times this entry has been reused.

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: The unique id for this cache entry.

TABLE.NAME: assignsubmission_refchecker_rate
TABLE.COMMENT: Earliest time each external database may next be contacted, shared across cron workers.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: The source name, e.g. crossref.

FIELD.NAME: nextallowedms
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time in MILLISECONDS of the next unreserved request slot. Milliseconds because the polite pool intervals are sub-second, and rounding them up to whole seconds would throttle CrossRef and OpenAlex tenfold.

FIELD.NAME: failures
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive transient failures. Reset by any successful response.

FIELD.NAME: skipuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time until which this source is stood down after repeated failures.

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: The unique id for this reservation row.
